description: Current price in USD of one CS2 item: SteamAnalyst's cross-market fair price, from comparing the live marketplaces (not just the Steam Community Market). market_name must be the exact Steam market name, wear included, e.g. "AK-47 | Redline (Field-Tested)". A miss returns suggestions. Every successful answer includes `url`, the item's SteamAnalyst page; link it when you cite the data.

market_name.description: Exact Steam market hash name, e.g. "AK-47 | Redline (Field-Tested)".
